# Join the Restorers !

In the magical Coquelicot Museum, paintings are portals towards living worlds ! Play as an art restorer and use your brushes to save the painted realms from a mysterious Eraser Artist. **This is a demo version.**

**Immersive art** - Rediscover the most famous paintings as immersive 3D worlds
[media]

**Restoration** - Find the differences between the flat originals and the immersive paintings and paint everything back to normal
[media]

**Creative freedom** - Help the visitors of the museum with creative quests and wake up your inner artist
[media]

**Sandbox** - Customize the museum with fun and easy to use art tools, such as the magical brush that turns 2D drawings into 3D objects !
[media]


# Demo vs. Full Game

This demo version is a short, first-taste of the complete game. Here what you can expect from the full game :

**More content** - The full game will be a 5-hour long adventure : explore multiple museum galleries and immersive paintings ; meet new inhabitants of the painted realms and complete dozens of creative quests.

**New Social mode** - Invite your friends in your museum with the multiplayer mode, show your art and paint together ! Share your creations easily with social media integrations.

**More creative tools** - More fancy brushes, a color-swap gun, a magic drawing machine... It'll be easier and funnier to customize your museum and to do the creative side quests.

Join us on Discord : https://discord.gg/dH8uKv7tm7
